description: The bar chart, titled "Context-Informed Grounding Supervision," compares the distribution of three categories—Context, Generated Response, and Other—across two conditions: "Ours" and "Standard." The horizontal axis represents the percentage distribution, with values ranging from 0% to 100%, while the vertical axis lists the two conditions. Each bar is segmented into three colored portions corresponding to the categories: blue for Context, orange for Generated Response, and green for Other. For the "Ours" condition, the Context category accounts for 60.6%, the Generated Response for 31.7%, and the Other category for 7.7%. In the "Standard" condition, the Context category is 23.6%, the Generated Response is 51.1%, and the Other category is 25.3%. The legend at the bottom clarifies the color coding for each category.
